user.title: Add Twinkly lights
user.description: Enter the IP address or host name of your Twinkly lights.

data_description.host: The IP address or host name of the lights on your network.

reconfigure.title: Change the host
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address or host name of these Twinkly lights.

data_description.host: The IP address or host name of the lights on your network.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Twinkly device at this host. Check the address and that the lights are powered on.

abort.already_configured: These lights are already set up.
abort.unsupported_firmware: These lights need firmware {min_firmware} or newer. Update them in the Twinkly app and try again.
abort.unsupported_device: These lights are not supported: Twinkly Canvas works only with lights that report RGB or RGBW LEDs.
abort.compatibility_mode_off: Compatibility mode is turned off on these lights. Turn it on in the Twinkly app and try again.
abort.core_twinkly_configured: These lights are already set up with Home Assistant's built-in Twinkly integration. Both integrations would keep logging each other out of the lights, so remove the built-in Twinkly entry first.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This host belongs to a different device than the one you are reconfiguring.

memory_full.message: There is not enough free memory on the lights for this. Delete movies you no longer need in the Twinkly app and try again.

too_many_movies.message: The lights hold as many movies as they can store. Delete a movie you no longer need in the Twinkly app and try again.

device_error.message: The Twinkly lights could not carry out the command: {error}

update_failed.message: Could not read the state of the Twinkly lights: {error}

unsupported_device.message: Twinkly Canvas cannot read the device information of these lights: {error}

wrong_device.message: A different Twinkly answers at {host}. Reconfigure the address.

compatibility_mode_off.message: Compatibility mode is turned off on these lights. Turn it on in the Twinkly app.

cannot_save_look.message: A look can be saved from a painting, the custom effect or another look, not from a built-in effect or a movie from the Twinkly app.

set_leds.name: Set LEDs
set_leds.description: Paints the selected LEDs in one colour and shows the result on the lights.

leds.name: LEDs
leds.description: LED numbers and ranges counted from 1, such as 1-37, 45, optionally followed by odd, even or every N (from M); or a group name, or all.

color.name: Colour
color.description: The colour as red, green and blue values. Give this or a colour name.

color_name.name: Colour name
color_name.description: A named colour. Give this or an RGB colour.

white.name: White
white.description: Warm white from 0 to 255, added to the colour on the white channel.

clear_others.name: Clear the others
clear_others.description: Turn off all LEDs that are not selected.

play_effect.name: Play effect
play_effect.description: Plays a moving effect on the selected LEDs and keeps it as the custom effect. The lights store it and play it by themselves.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: Up to 3 colours, each a colour name or a list of red, green and blue values, such as red and [192, 192, 192]. Leave empty for the effect's own colours.

leds.name: LEDs
leds.description: The LEDs the effect runs on: numbers and ranges counted from 1, a group name or all.

keep_others.name: Keep the others
keep_others.description: LEDs outside the effect keep their painted colours. When off, they are turned off.

apply_look.name: Apply look
apply_look.description: Shows a saved look on the lights.

look.name: Look
look.description: The name of the saved look.

save_look.name: Save look
save_look.description: Saves what the lights show now as a look: the painting, the custom effect or a copy of the current look. A look with the same name is replaced.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name of the look, 1 to 40 characters.

find_leds.name: Find LEDs
find_leds.description: Blinks the selected LEDs for a few seconds with the others dimmed, then shows what was on before.

leds.name: LEDs
leds.description: The LEDs to find: numbers and ranges counted from 1, a group name or all.

save_group.name: Save group
save_group.description: Saves a named LED selection for the other actions and the card. A group with the same name is replaced.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name of the group, 1 to 40 characters.

leds.name: LEDs
leds.description: The LED numbers and ranges in the group, counted from 1.

core_twinkly_conflict.title: {name} is also set up with the built-in Twinkly integration
core_twinkly_conflict.description: The lights accept one login at a time, so Twinkly Canvas and Home Assistant's built-in Twinkly integration keep logging each other out of {name}. Remove the built-in Twinkly entry for these lights under Settings > Devices & services > Twinkly, then reload Twinkly Canvas.
